title: Activation magnitude normalizer: INT8 adaptor + runtime hotpath for adaptive compensation
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Deliver an activation-magnitude normalizer component that produces INT8-compatible scale/adaptor profiles (per-matrix hybrid: per-channel for matmuls, per-tensor for elementwise / norm ops) and a lightweight runtime hotpath that applies compensation when distribution drift or KV-cache heavy request patterns are observed. This ticket covers the offline profile generation, validation harness integration, runtime selector + kernel patch, and canary rollout plan.

Scope:
- Offline calibration tool that computes activation magnitude histograms and derives per-operation compensator factors.
- Hybrid profile format (JSON lines) compatible with existing profile manager.
- Runtime hotpath in serving runtime to load compensators per model version and select at request-time based on observed activation percentile (p99/p999 triggers).
- Fallback strategy to FP16 kernel when compensation fails regression checks.

Out of scope:
- New quantized kernels (we will reuse existing INT8 kernels); hardware-specific kernel re-writes are separate tickets.
- Full FP8 conversion flow (handled by FP8 track).

Success criteria:
- Offline profiles reduce end-to-end generation perplexity regression to <= 1% on golden eval set vs FP16 for benchmark models (llama-2-7b, mix of Llama/OPT variants).
- Serving latency increase <= 5% p95 for typical small-batch traffic when hotpath enabled.
- Canary rollout with automated rollback on accuracy regression or latency SLO violations.
acceptance_criteria: Generator produces per-op compensator JSON + summary metrics for each calibration corpus
CI regression checks (golden-corpus) pass for top-3 validated models within 1% perplexity delta
Runtime loads compensator file at model load and exposes selector flag in Console
Canary rollout policy triggers automatic rollback if accuracy or latency thresholds breached
Documentation (Confluence) and SDK examples for toggling compensation are shipped
rollout_plan: Merge generator + runtime changes behind runtime flag: activation_normalizer.v1
Run offline calibration on nightly pipeline for 5 representative models and upload profiles to artifact store
Enable canary for internal dev org (10% traffic) for 48 hours - monitor perf and perplexity
Expand to 50% if no regressions for 72 hours, otherwise rollback
Graduate to GA and enable default-off toggle for Dedicated/private customers
test_plan: Unit tests for compensator math (per-channel/per-tensor aggregation)
Integration test: model load with compensator file + synthetic inference workload (KV-cache heavy)
Regression harness: golden prompt set (1000 prompts) run offline vs FP16 baseline; CI gate enforces <1% perplexity regression
Perf microbenchmarks comparing p95/p99 latency with and without hotpath at 1, 8, 32 batch sizes
Small canary smoke test that intentionally injects a bad profile and asserts rollback behavior
